mapper.select: SELECT P.PACKAGE_ID AS packageId, P.PACKAGE_NAME AS packageName, P.PACKAGE_DESCRIPTION AS packageDescription, P.PACKAGE_GRADE AS packageGrade, P.PACKAGE_PRICE AS packagePrice, P.PACKAGE_STATUS AS packageStatus, P.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, P.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, P.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt, ( SELECT PI.IMAGE_URL FROM PACKAGE_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.PACKAGE_ID = P.PACKAGE_ID AND PI.IMAGE_TYPE = 'THUMBNAIL' ) AS thumbnailUrl FROM PACKAGE P WHERE P.PACKAGE_GRADE = #{packageGrade} AND P.PACKAGE_STATUS = 'SELLING' ORDER BY P.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PACKAGE WHERE PACKAGE_GRADE = #{packageGrade} AND PACKAGE_STATUS = 'SELLING'
